qualification.details: Candidates who have passed their B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech/Diploma/ITI/B.A./B.Com degree in the year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates who passed the qualifying examination earlier than 2022 are not eligible. Only candidates who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates are eligible to apply. Diploma and Graduate candidates must have registered their names at https://nats.education.gov.in; non-registered candidates are likely to be rejected. salary_details.details: Stipend for all three apprenticeship categories (ITI, Diploma, Graduate Apprentice) is as per rules. The notification does not specify an exact stipend amount.

selection_process: The notification does not specify a written test
interview or a detailed merit-list procedure. It states that verification of credentials will be carried out for selected candidates prior to creation of the apprenticeship contract

and that any deviation or non-conformity with the desired qualification will lead to summary rejection of candidature. Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification Certificate after joining. The exact basis on which candidates are shortlisted/selected (e.g. merit percentage) is not specified in the notification.
how_to_apply: Diploma and Graduate candidates: register at https://nats.education.gov.in. ITI candidates: register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Duly fill the application form (format provided with the advertisement).
Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents, and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
Send the completed hard-copy application by post to: Director, SSPL, Kind Attention: HRD, SSPL, DRDO, Lucknow Road, Timarpur, Delhi – 110054.
Ensure the application reaches SSPL on or before 21 August 2026.

Note: This recruitment does not have an online application/apply-online step beyond the initial NATS/Apprenticeship India portal registration - the actual application form must be submitted physically by post.

content_sections.heading: SSPL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: SSPL has released a combined 41 vacancies across three apprenticeship categories. The exact number of vacancies for each individual category is not specified in the notification - it may vary depending on the laboratory's requirement. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS categories will apply as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprentice Rules 1992, and the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules 2015. Category-wise vacancy break-up is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates who have passed their B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech/Diploma/ITI/B.A./B.Com degree in the year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates who passed the qualifying examination earlier than 2022 are not eligible. Only candidates who completed the qualifying examination as regular candidates are eligible to apply. Diploma and Graduate candidates must have registered their names at https://nats.education.gov.in ; non-registered candidates are likely to be rejected. ITI candidates must have registered their names at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in ; non-registered candidates are likely to be rejected. Age limit is not specified in the notification.

rows.qualification: ITI (First Division) in Fitter, Electronics Mechanic, Electrician, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA), Machinist, or Carpenter; and 10th with First Division
Diploma (First Division) in Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Computer Science; and 10th & Diploma with First Division

Regular Graduation degree (First Division) in Physics, Chemistry, Maths or Computer Science, OR B.A./B.Com, OR B.E./B.Tech (First Division) in Electronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Communication Engineering, VLSI, or Chemical Engineering from a recognized University/Institution

content_sections.heading: SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend for all three apprenticeship categories (ITI, Diploma, Graduate Apprentice) is as per rules . The notification does not specify an exact stipend amount.

content_sections.heading: SSPL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a written test, interview or a detailed merit-list procedure. It states that verification of credentials will be carried out for selected candidates prior to creation of the apprenticeship contract, and that any deviation or non-conformity with the desired qualification will lead to summary rejection of candidature. Selected candidates must submit a Police Verification Certificate after joining. The exact basis on which candidates are shortlisted/selected (e.g. merit percentage) is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Solid State Physics Laboratory (SSPL), DRDO, Delhi, to engage candidates as ITI, Diploma or Graduate Apprentice against 41 vacancies, under Advertisement No. 625/HR/Apprentice/2026/M/02.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 41 vacancies combined across ITI Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice and Graduate Apprentice categories. The category-wise split is not specified, and the number may vary depending on requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The completed application form must reach SSPL by post on or before 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by category: ITI (First Division) in specified trades with 10th First Division for ITI Apprentice; Diploma (First Division) in Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Computer Science with 10th and Diploma First Division for Diploma Apprentice; and a First Division Graduation/B.E./B.Tech in specified subjects for Graduate Apprentice.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: First register on the applicable national apprenticeship portal (NATS for Diploma/Graduate, Apprenticeship India for ITI), then send the duly filled hard-copy application form by post to SSPL, Delhi, along with self-attested documents, by 21 August 2026. There is no separate apply-online submission step.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for SSPL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per rules; an exact amount is not specified in the notification.
